surfaces.label: WMF text record bounds
surfaces.notes: Investigator preliminary: record size is checked only for iterator advancement, while EXTTEXTOUT/TEXTOUT lengths read from the entire file, permitting overlapping 65,535-byte text copies per tiny record.

surfaces.label: Relationship-selected auxiliary XML admission
surfaces.notes: src/admission.rs:534-567 checks .xml/.rels and nonstandard main part only. src/convert/mod.rs:773 admits first, load_stylesheet at 3480 reads main_rel_part(styles) and at 3497 calls unchecked Dom::parse_xdocument. main_rel_part at 21310 resolves arbitrary internal targets. src/xmllinq/parse.rs:555-661 recursively parses elements without depth guard. Investigator proposes styles relationship to word/styles.bin with extreme nested XML bypassing max_xml_depth=256; no execution performed.

surfaces.label: HTML altChunk table expansion
surfaces.notes: src/convert/altchunk.rs:562-566 parses attacker td/th colspan as unrestricted usize; end_table :469-475 sums spans into cols and :489-491 emits one <w:gridCol> per cols. A single colspan='4294967295' drives billions of iterations/allocations before DOM/layout, independent of page pixel cap.

candidate.title: Pull requests execute attacker-controlled code on shared self-hosted runners
candidate.attacker: fork pull-request contributor whose workflow run is permitted by repository Actions policy
candidate.invariant: Untrusted pull-request code must not inherit internal runner/network authority.
candidate.evidence: ci.yml triggers on pull_request without a trust guard; lint runs-on self-hosted, checks out PR source and invokes local .github/actions/mbx and cargo. mbx/action.yml documents a shared private Docker network/cache. Sibling docs/adoption/roundtrip also use self-hosted PR execution.
candidate.uncertainty: Runner lifecycle, isolation, GitHub approval policy and external fork run enablement need source-backed assessment.
